rawFindings.title: Removal of Unicode line separator \u2028 and paragraph separator \u2029 from VALID_STRING_ESCAPES
rawFindings.explanation: The constant VALID_STRING_ESCAPES originally included the Unicode characters \u2028 and \u2029, which are line and paragraph separators respectively and valid escapes in string literals. Their removal from the set means these escapes may now be considered useless escapes incorrectly, causing false positive lint errors on strings containing these characters.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore \u2028 and \u2029 characters to the VALID_STRING_ESCAPES set, i.e. change line 27 to `const VALID_STRING_ESCAPES = new Set("\\nrvtbfux\n\r\u2028\u2029");`.

rawFindings.explanation: The original code included '\u2028' and '\u2029' (Unicode line separator and paragraph separator) in the set of valid string escapes. These characters are valid escape sequences in strings, and removing them makes detection of valid escapes incorrect, potentially causing false positives or negatives during linting.
rawFindings.suggestion:
Restore '\u2028' and '\u2029' to the VALID_STRING_ESCAPES set on line 27 by changing the line to:

rawFindings.title: Removal of valid test cases for \u2028 and \u2029 escapes in no-useless-escape rule tests
rawFindings.explanation: The test cases that verified that escaping \u2028 and \u2029 characters is valid were removed. These tests ensure that the linter correctly recognizes these escapes as necessary and valid. Their removal weakens test coverage and may allow regressions regarding these escape sequences.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the two test lines checking 'var foo = \'foo \\u2028 bar\'' and 'var foo = \'foo \\u2029 bar\'' at line 105 to ensure that these escape cases are tested.
